title: Heart-rate variability from ECG beat annotations
summary: A Holter ECG is a voltage trace; cardiologists label each beat; the intervals between normal beats carry the autonomic nervous system's control of the heart, and ectopic beats or gaps must be removed before measuring it.

concepts.label: ECG record
concepts.description: One person's ambulatory (Holter) ECG in a PhysioNet database: signals, sampling rate, header notes.

facts.text: The MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (1980) has 48 half-hour two-lead records at 360 Hz, each beat labelled by two or more cardiologists.

children.label: ECG signal
children.description: Lead MLII voltage in mV: (ADC units − 1024) / 200 for mitdb; LightWAVE sends it delta-coded.

children.label: Beat annotation
children.description: A labelled beat at a sample time: N normal, A atrial premature, V ventricular premature, F fusion; plus rhythm (+), noise (~) and artefact (|) marks.

facts.text: PhysioNet's annotation codes (N, A, V, F, ...) are listed in the WFDB documentation.

children.label: Premature ventricular contraction
children.description: A beat started in the ventricles before the sinus beat was due; wide QRS, followed by a compensatory pause.

children.label: Noise and artefact segments
children.description: Stretches the annotators could not read; a gap in beats becomes one false long interval.

children.label: Subject (age, sex, medication)
children.description: Who was recorded; HRV depends strongly on age and medication. Only in the header notes, not fetched here.

concepts.label: Heart-rate variability
concepts.description: Variation of the interval between heartbeats, a window on autonomic (vagal and sympathetic) control of the sinus node.

facts.text: The 1996 Task Force of the European Society of Cardiology and NASPE standardised SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50 and the LF/HF spectral bands.

children.label: RR and NN intervals
children.description: Time between successive beats; NN when both beats are normal (and the interval plausible).

children.label: Poincaré plot (SD1, SD2)
children.description: RRₙ₊₁ against RRₙ; SD1 = RMSSD/√2 across the identity line, SD2 along it.

children.label: Frequency-domain HRV (LF, HF, LF/HF)
children.description: Power of the resampled tachogram in 0.04–0.15 Hz and 0.15–0.4 Hz bands (breathing); needs a spectrum (Python step).

children.label: Nonlinear HRV (DFA α1, sample entropy)
children.description: Fractal and complexity measures of the NN series.

concepts.label: Compensatory pause
concepts.description: After a PVC the sinus node keeps its rhythm, so coupling + pause ≈ 2 × NN.

facts.text: A full compensatory pause is typical of ventricular premature beats, which usually don't conduct back to reset the sinus node; atrial premature beats usually do reset it.

concepts.label: Beat detection (device side)
concepts.description: How a monitor finds R peaks itself (Pan–Tompkins); its errors are what NN editing must clean in real devices.
